YouTube chat streaming protocol

The stream_list.proto subset used by this client is adapted from Google's
YouTube Live Streaming API documentation:
https://developers.google.com/youtube/data/live/streaming-live-chat

Code samples on that page are licensed under Apache License 2.0.
Modifications by Hardcoon, 2026: reduced to read-only chat fields and added a
C# namespace. The wire field numbers and service name are preserved.
See LICENSE_APACHE_2.txt. This component's terms are not replaced by the
application license. YouTube and Google are trademarks of Google LLC.

The .NET client uses Grpc.Net.Client (Apache-2.0) and Google.Protobuf (BSD-3-Clause).
Their notices are included alongside this file. Grpc.Tools is build-only.
